accepted.evidence: Turner 12115 gives Punjabi belā ‘time’, Kashmiri vēla ‘time, hour’ and Odia beḷa ‘daytime’. Batote bɛla is the morning response beside a second morning word; it selects a particular time of day from this lexical family. Turner considers a much older Dravidian input possible, which does not identify a modern donor. Source image and reviewed import row checked; no transcription or identity changes.
